schema.text: Where you go most often, is there a good place to leave your bike?
schema.help: Safe means your bike is protected from theft, for example a rack you can lock it to.

options.text: No, there is nowhere safe to leave it
There is some, but too little or too far away
Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe
Yes, I can usually find a good place

en.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Where you go most often, is there a good place to leave your bike?
en.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Safe means your bike is protected from theft, for example a rack you can lock it to.
en.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: No, there is nowhere safe to leave it
en.#There is some, but too little or too fa: There is some, but too little or too far away
en.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe
en.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Yes, I can usually find a good place

it.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Nei posti dove vai più spesso, c'è un buon posto dove lasciare la bici?
it.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Sicuro significa che la bici è protetta dai furti, per esempio un archetto a cui puoi legarla.
it.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: No, non c'è nessun posto sicuro dove lasciarla
it.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Ce n'è qualcuno, ma troppo poco o troppo lontano
it.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Sì, ma non è sempre comodo o sicuro
it.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Sì, di solito trovo un buon posto

fr.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Là où vous allez le plus souvent, y a-t-il un bon endroit pour laisser votre vélo ?
fr.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Sûr signifie que votre vélo est protégé contre le vol, par exemple un support où l'attacher.
fr.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: Non, il n'y a aucun endroit sûr pour le laisser
fr.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Il y en a, mais trop peu ou trop loin
fr.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Oui, mais ce n'est pas toujours pratique ou sûr
fr.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Oui, je trouve en général un bon endroit

de.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Gibt es dort, wo Sie am häufigsten hinfahren, einen guten Platz, um Ihr Rad abzustellen?
de.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Sicher heißt: Ihr Rad ist vor Diebstahl geschützt, zum Beispiel ein Ständer, an dem Sie es anschließen können.
de.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: Nein, es gibt keinen sicheren Ort dafür
de.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Es gibt welche, aber zu wenige oder zu weit weg
de.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Ja, aber nicht immer praktisch oder sicher
de.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Ja, ich finde meistens einen guten Platz

tr.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: En sık gittiğiniz yerlerde bisikletinizi bırakabileceğiniz iyi bir yer var mı?
tr.#Safe means your bike is protected from: Güvenli, bisikletinizin hırsızlığa karşı korunması demektir; örneğin kilitleyebileceğiniz bir park demiri.
tr.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: Hayır, bırakabileceğim güvenli bir yer yok
tr.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Var ama çok az veya çok uzak
tr.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Evet, ama her zaman elverişli veya güvenli değil
tr.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: Evet, genellikle iyi bir yer bulabiliyorum
tr.#Yes, always safe and handy: Evet, her zaman güvenli ve elverişli

fa.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: در جاهایی که بیشتر می‌روید، جای خوبی برای گذاشتن دوچرخه هست؟
fa.#Safe means your bike is protected from: «امن» یعنی دوچرخه شما از دزدی محافظت شود، مثلاً جایی که بتوانید آن را قفل کنید.
fa.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: نه، جای امنی برای گذاشتن آن نیست
fa.#There is some, but too little or too fa: کمی هست، اما خیلی کم است یا دور است
fa.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: بله، اما همیشه در دسترس یا امن نیست
fa.#Yes, I can usually find a good place: بله، معمولاً جای خوبی پیدا می‌کنم
fa.#Yes, always safe and handy: بله، همیشه امن و در دسترس

hu.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: Ott, ahová a leggyakrabban jár, van jó hely a bicikli otthagyásához?
hu.#Safe means your bike is protected from: A biztonságos azt jelenti, hogy a kerékpárja védett a lopás ellen, például van állvány, amelyhez lezárhatja.
hu.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: Nem, nincs biztonságos hely, ahol otthagyhatnám
hu.#There is some, but too little or too fa: Van, de túl kevés, vagy túl messze van
hu.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: Igen, de nem mindig könnyen elérhető vagy biztonságos
hu.#Yes, always safe and handy: Igen, mindig biztonságos és könnyen elérhető

ar.#Where you go most often, is there a goo: في وجهاتك الأكثر تكرارًا، هل يوجد مكان جيد لترك دراجتك؟
ar.#Safe means your bike is protected from: «آمن» يعني أن دراجتك محمية من السرقة، مثل حامل يمكنك قفلها به.
ar.#No, there is nowhere safe to leave it: لا، لا يوجد مكان آمن لتركه
ar.#There is some, but too little or too fa: توجد بعض الأماكن، لكنها قليلة جدًا أو بعيدة
ar.#Yes, but it isn't always handy or safe: نعم، لكنه ليس دائمًا قريبًا أو آمنًا
